correctness.rationale: The final claim is the D6 rational homology character of M(GP(6,2)); the already published 22-sphere homotopy type supplies the homology concentration. Direct signed Lefschetz fixed-simplex enumeration of 1037 faces for each of 12 automorphisms gives rotation traces (22,0,-2,6,-2,0) and zero reflection traces. Exact character inner products yield multiplicities (2,2,1,1,3,5), with two invariant directions. An independent 506-pair acyclic Morse reduction with primitive integral top boundary corroborates the previously published homotopy premise.

value.rationale: The full group character is a natural invariant of a canonical cubic polyhedral graph, refining a known 22-dimensional homology rank by distinguishing six irreducible constituent multiplicities and a two-dimensional invariant subspace.
